  ------------------------

  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/django__django-11019/django/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/dja
  ngo__django-11019/django && pytest test_combine_media 
  (forms_tests.tests.test_media.FormsMediaTestCase), test_construction 
  (forms_tests.tests.test_media.FormsMediaTestCase), test_form_media 
  (forms_tests.tests.test_media.FormsMediaTestCase), 
  test_media_deduplication 
  (forms_tests.tests.test_media.FormsMediaTestCase), test_media_inheritance 
  (forms_tests.tests.test_media.FormsMediaTestCase)
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/dja
  ngo__django-11019/django && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnet
  s/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/django__django-11019/fix_11019.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/django__django-11019/fix_report_11019.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述

  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/django__django-11019/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径

  (forms_tests.tests.test_media.FormsMediaTestCase), test_form_media

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
